question: In January 2024, how many yellow-taxi pickups happened inside the rectangle around Midtown Manhattan bounded by 74.01°W to 73.96°W and 40.74°N to 40.78°N?
sql: WITH midtown AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.01, 40.74, -73.96, 40.78) AS geom) SELECT count(*) AS pickup_count FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id CROSS JOIN midtown m WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND ST_Intersects(z.geometry, m.geom);

question: Which taxi zones are completely inside the rectangle that covers Manhattan from 74.05°W to 73.90°W and 40.70°N to 40.88°N? Show their names and boroughs.
sql: SELECT z.zone, z.borough FROM nyc_taxi_zones z WHERE ST_Within(z.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.05, 40.70, -73.90, 40.88)) ORDER BY z.zone;

question: What is the overall latitude/longitude bounding box of all taxi zones in Brooklyn?
sql: WITH brooklyn_bbox AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS bbox FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough = 'Brooklyn') SELECT ST_XMin(bbox) AS min_lon, ST_YMin(bbox) AS min_lat, ST_XMax(bbox) AS max_lon, ST_YMax(bbox) AS max_lat FROM brooklyn_bbox;

question: Among January 2024 yellow-taxi trips, how many started in the rectangle around the Upper West Side between 74.00°W and 73.95°W, 40.76°N and 40.81°N, and ended in the rectangle around Downtown Brooklyn between 73.99°W and 73.96°W, 40.68°N and 40.71°N?
sql: WITH uws AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.00, 40.76, -73.95, 40.81) AS geom), downtown_bk AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.99, 40.68, -73.96, 40.71) AS geom) SELECT count(*) AS trip_count FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pz ON t.PULocationID = pz.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones dz ON t.DOLocationID = dz.location_id CROSS JOIN uws CROSS JOIN downtown_bk WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND ST_Intersects(pz.geometry, uws.geom) AND ST_Intersects(dz.geometry, downtown_bk.geom);

question: For yellow-taxi pickups made between 3:00 and 4:00 in the morning during January 2024, what is the overall latitude/longitude bounding box of the pickup zones?
sql: WITH early_trips AS (SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) = 3), bbox AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(z.geometry) AS geom FROM early_trips e JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON e.PULocationID = z.location_id) SELECT ST_XMin(geom) AS min_lon, ST_YMin(geom) AS min_lat, ST_XMax(geom) AS max_lon, ST_YMax(geom) AS max_lat FROM bbox;

question: Which taxi zones intersect the rectangle around JFK Airport, from 73.83°W to 73.75°W and 40.62°N to 40.66°N, and had at least 1,000 January 2024 dropoffs? Show the zone name, borough, and dropoff count.
sql: WITH jfk AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.83, 40.62, -73.75, 40.66) AS geom), dropoffs AS (SELECT DOLocationID, count(*) AS cnt FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_dropoff_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND tpep_dropoff_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' GROUP BY DOLocationID) SELECT z.zone, z.borough, d.cnt AS dropoff_count FROM nyc_taxi_zones z JOIN dropoffs d ON z.location_id = d.DOLocationID CROSS JOIN jfk WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, jfk.geom) AND d.cnt >= 1000 ORDER BY d.cnt DESC;
